method: OpenStreetMap way 272687522 (building=yes, name='MI-62') used verbatim. The TDR numbers its service buildings by their place on the ring ('the locations of these service buildings are used as the basis for numbering locations in the FMI ring'), so the building named MI-62 stands at the MI-62 straight section; its centroid is 9 m from the derived centre of that straight on geometry:fermilab-main-injector-ring (an independent check that was not used to place the ring).
name: Main Injector service building MI-62 (OpenStreetMap)
